articles.headline: Thomas Tuchel on England World Cup semifinal vs Argentina: Nowhere in world I'd rather be
articles.description: Thomas Tuchel has said there is "nowhere else in the whole wide world" he would rather be than leading England into a World Cup semifinal against reigning champions Argentina.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Spidercam debate rumbles on as four semifinalists confirmed
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the competition as we now know our four World Cup semifinalists.

articles.headline: How have England fared in major semifinals? Record ahead of Argentina World Cup clash
articles.description: England will next take to the field against Argentina after securing a 2-1 win over Norway on Saturday to book a fourth World Cup semifinal appearance.

articles.headline: Why are there hydration breaks at the 2026 World Cup, and why has FIFA been criticised?
articles.description: All 104 matches at the 2026 World Cup are stopping for two hydration breaks. Why have they been stipulated by FIFA, and why have they been criticised?

articles.headline: Free World Cup 2026 predictor: Simulate your road to the final
articles.description: Put your football knowledge to the test with ESPN's free World Cup 2026 predictor games and forecast every twist and turn of the tournament.

articles.headline: Senegal sack manager Pape Thiaw after World Cup exit
articles.description: Senegal have sacked manager Pape Thiaw in the wake of their exit from the World Cup in the round of 32.
